description: This pie chart visually represents the distribution of categories within a dataset, likely for evaluating large language models' attribution capabilities, with ten distinct segments. The largest segment, colored blue, corresponds to "Business" and accounts for 24.3% of the total. The second largest, a teal-colored segment, is labeled "Econ. & Fin." at 18.4%. Other categories include "Daily Life" (7.1%, light blue), "Pet & Animal" (5.5%, orange), "Med & Health" (6.7%, green), "History" (8.2%, yellow), "Law" (5.1%, pinkish-red), "Science" (6.7%, light blue), "Geography" (2.7%, yellow), "Math" (1.2%, dark green), and "Game&Anime" (8.2%, orange). Each category is labeled with its name and percentage value, connected by lines to its respective slice. The chart includes a legend-like structure with the percentage values displayed next to the category labels. The segments are arranged in a clockwise order, generally from largest to smallest, with "Business" at the top right and "Math" as the smallest segment at the bottom right.
